test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Many effort have been taken (1)/ by the technical team (2)/ to improve system performance (3)/ without reducing quality. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "**Many effort have been taken**."
 
• The term "**effort**" is singular, but the context of the sentence suggests a plural form is needed. It should be "**many efforts**."
 
• Additionally, "**have been taken**" is correct for plural subjects like "**efforts**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Many efforts have been taken by the technical team to improve system performance without reducing quality."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "by the technical team,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "to improve system performance"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "without reducing quality."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
